summary: The feature is additive. Single-link creation already lives in LinkService.create, which owns URL validation, alias policy, collision retry and the unique-constraint race handling. A bulk endpoint should be a thin new controller plus a small orchestration service that calls LinkService.create per item and converts domain exceptions into per-item results. No schema, configuration or existing API changes are needed.

impactedFiles.reason: Per-item orchestration over LinkService.create with exception-to-result mapping
Domain result type: created link or rejection reason
Response DTO with counts and per-item results

dataFlows: Client -> RateLimitFilter (POST /api/v1/links* is limited, so the bulk path is covered) -> BulkLinkController -> BulkLinkService -> LinkService.create -> LinkRepository.saveAndFlush per item
architecturalNotes: LinkService.create is deliberately not transactional; each insert has its own transaction, which gives per-item atomicity for free
Domain exceptions (InvalidUrlException, InvalidAliasException, AliasAlreadyExistsException) map to the same problem types as the single endpoint
Reuse LinkResponse.from for consistent link representation
